name: Monitor Manager Lite
headline: Monitor Brightness On Stream Deck
description:
Monitor Manager Lite is the free, focused version of Monitor Manager for Windows. It does one everyday job well: control the brightness of one monitor directly from Stream Deck.

Set exact brightness presets, create Brightness Up / Down keys, or use a Stream Deck+ dial for continuous adjustment. External monitors use Windows monitor APIs / DDC where supported, while laptop internal panels use the Windows internal brightness path.

Lite is intentionally simple. It does not include monitor power, refresh-rate switching, resolution, input switching, HDR, orientation, topology, multi-monitor orchestration, or saved Monitor Profiles.

Need the full display control center? Monitor Manager Pro adds those deeper controls plus whole-setup Monitor Profiles.

Starter profiles are included for Standard / MK.2, XL, Stream Deck+, and Virtual Stream Deck.

Windows 10 or newer. Hardware support depends on the connected display and Windows capabilities.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes: Initial release. Free one-monitor brightness control with exact presets, Brightness Up / Down, Stream Deck+ dial support, laptop internal-brightness fallback, and bundled profiles.
